A summary of comfort stops
This article is for everyone using the desk
Companion Animal Travel Desk comfort stop guidance

Aurelia Skyways keeps pet travel orderly and calm. The Companion Animal Travel Desk gives clear guidance before departure so travelers can prepare crates, carriers, and documents without delay.

The shift coordinator reviews comfort needs with care and keeps the process practical. Mixed loads are checked early, and the traveler is told what to expect at the desk and at handoff. If a cat is traveling, <<FACT F061>>. The same careful review applies to every accepted animal, with attention to airflow, hydration, and rest.

For small dogs, entry planning starts with age and readiness. <<FACT F074>>. The desk then confirms the crate fit, the label details, and the route notes so the animal stays secure through the journey. Travelers should keep the pet calm, avoid last-minute changes, and arrive with all required papers ready.

If a concern comes up, the welfare coordinator can review it with the desk team and advise on the next step. For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
